note: Local override only: node merges these URLs into peers.json. Empty is fine — bootstrap now falls back to the DNS TXT seed (seed.agentcoin.work, AGT_DNS_SEEDS) and then to the built-in peer list in seeds.mjs, so a fresh node needs no hand-typed addresses. AGT_SEED_FALLBACK=0 and AGT_DNS_SEEDS=off disable those layers. See docs/JOINING.md.
